findings.quote: No desk is calling a top
findings.why: BTIG flags NYSE downside volume at 54% as a level historically associated with cycle tops (March 2000, November 2007, November 2021) and The Bear Traps Report titles its piece 'Turning Point', calling breadth the worst in nearly 100 years and record convertible issuance a classic stress signal preceding sharp corrections.
findings.fix: Replace with a statement the corpus supports, such as 'Only the technical desks are flagging cycle-top signals, and several are paying for downside protection'.
